caption:
Read that 11,000 new homes are coming and decided to wait for one? 🏗️

Waiting feels free. It isn't. HDB says site works only start from late 2027, and the homes come in phases over about 10 years. Every year you wait is another year of rent or a smaller flat.

Compare two paths: buy what fits now, or wait with the real years and costs counted.

Comment your flat type and town, and we'll tell you which path fits you 👇

HDB release 28 Oct 2026 via AsiaOne, Mothership.
